description: Initial retrieval benchmark for the official MEA Pravasi Bharatiya Kendra integrated facility management tender and draft agreement.

source_documents.provenance: Official Ministry of External Affairs source: https://www.mea.gov.in/Portal/Tender/3768_1/1_PBK_IFMC_Tender_Document-1.pdf

cases.question: Which Ministry issued the tender for the facility management services?
cases.expected_answer: The Ministry of External Affairs issued the tender on behalf of the President of India.

expected_evidence.anchor: On behalf of the President of India, Ministry of External Affairs invites online bids

cases.question: Where are the integrated facility management services to be provided?
cases.expected_answer: The services are for Pravasi Bharatiya Kendra at 15-A, Rizal Marg, Chanakyapuri, New Delhi-110021.

expected_evidence.anchor: Pravasi Bharatiya Kendra, 15-A, Rizal Marg, Chanakyapuri, New Delhi-110021

cases.question: What bid system does the notice require?
cases.expected_answer: The notice requires bids under a two-bid system.

expected_evidence.anchor: invites online bids under TWO BID SYSTEM

cases.question: What is the initial validity period if the contract is awarded?
cases.expected_answer: The contract is initially valid for one year, subject to the stated terms.

expected_evidence.anchor: initially valid for a period of ONE YEAR

cases.question: What must the contractor provide for round-the-clock housekeeping service?
cases.expected_answer: The contractor must provide housekeeping daily with relievers and make twenty-four-hour service available throughout the year.

expected_evidence.anchor: Housekeeping services are to be provided on a daily basis, along with relievers

cases.question: Who determines the duties, allocation, and work for housekeeping services?
cases.expected_answer: The duties, allocation, and work are to be as per MEA's discretion.

expected_evidence.anchor: The duties, allocation and work will be as per the discretion of MEA

cases.question: What worker verification is required before deployment?
cases.expected_answer: The service provider must deploy only police-verified and well-trained workers as required by the approved scope of work.

expected_evidence.anchor: deploy only police verified and well- trained workers

cases.question: What records must the provider maintain for site operations?
cases.expected_answer: The provider must maintain site documents, SOPs, checklists, and trackers and submit draft operational materials for MEA approval.

expected_evidence.anchor: provide and maintain all site documents, SOPs, Checklists, Trackers

cases.question: How often is the contractor paid for services rendered?
cases.expected_answer: The contractor is paid monthly for services rendered in the preceding month.

expected_evidence.anchor: paid on a monthly basis for the services rendered in the preceding month

cases.question: When should the contractor submit its monthly invoice?
cases.expected_answer: The contractor should submit a correct invoice within ten days of the succeeding month.

expected_evidence.anchor: within 10 days of the succeeding month

cases.question: Within what period will acceptable invoices be paid?
cases.expected_answer: Payment will be released within thirty days of submission of acceptable invoices.

expected_evidence.anchor: payment shall be released within 30 days of submission of acceptable invoices

cases.question: What is the performance security deposit percentage?
cases.expected_answer: The performance security deposit is ten percent of the accepted contract value.

expected_evidence.anchor: sum equivalent to 10% of the accepted contract value

cases.question: What notice follows a breach before MEA may terminate?
cases.expected_answer: For a breach, MEA may cancel or terminate after giving one month's notice.

expected_evidence.anchor: terminate the contract after giving one month’s notice

cases.question: What is the consequence of engaging a subcontractor?
cases.expected_answer: Engaging a subcontractor or transferring the contract can lead to forfeiture of the security deposit, cancellation, and a damages claim.

expected_evidence.anchor: sub-contractor or transfer the contract

cases.question: How many one-year extensions may MEA grant?
cases.expected_answer: The contract may be extended two times, by one year at a time, subject to satisfactory services.

expected_evidence.anchor: may be extended two times, by one year at a time

cases.question: What condition is attached to the possible contract extensions?
cases.expected_answer: Extensions are on the same terms and rates, subject to satisfactory services provided by the vendor.

expected_evidence.anchor: subject to satisfactory services provided by the vendor

cases.question: Which service areas are included in the integrated facility management scope?
cases.expected_answer: The scope includes housekeeping, glass cleaning, pest and rodent control, horticulture, security, and front/back office support services.

expected_evidence.anchor: Housekeeping Services, Glass cleaning, Pest & Rodent Control, Horticulture works, Security Services, Front/Back office support services

cases.question: What does housekeeping cover on a daily basis?
cases.expected_answer: It covers upkeep and maintenance of common areas and the interiors of guest rooms, with furniture shifting when required.

expected_evidence.anchor: Housekeeping Services for Pravasi Bharatiya Kendra

cases.question: What service availability level is required for housekeeping?
cases.expected_answer: Twenty-four-hour service must be available throughout the year, with daily schedules.

expected_evidence.anchor: Twenty-four hour service must be available throughout the year

cases.question: How often must an experienced person visit PBK for preventive maintenance?
cases.expected_answer: An experienced person must personally visit PBK daily in every shift and ensure planned preventive maintenance is followed.

expected_evidence.anchor: personally visit PBK daily in every shift and ensure Planned Preventive Maintenance

cases.question: What staffing coverage must the provider maintain?
cases.expected_answer: The provider must organize staff so all services are manned and operated on a 24x7 basis or as ordered by management.

expected_evidence.anchor: all services are manned, operated on 24x7 basis

cases.question: What penalty applies when deployed staff are absent?
cases.expected_answer: A penalty of Rs.1000 per absentee per day is deducted, in addition to the absentee's salary amount.

expected_evidence.anchor: penalty of Rs.1000/- per absentee per day

cases.question: What deduction applies when machinery or equipment is missing?
cases.expected_answer: Rs.2000 per missing machine or equipment per day is deducted from outstanding bills.

expected_evidence.anchor: penalty of Rs 2000/- per machine/equipment per day

cases.question: What is the maximum deduction for an unsatisfactory assigned work deficiency?
cases.expected_answer: Up to twenty thousand may be deducted for each deficiency from the respective month's bill.

expected_evidence.anchor: amount of up to twenty thousand will be deducted for each deficiency

cases.question: What responsibility does the provider have for licenses and statutory responsibilities?
cases.expected_answer: The provider must obtain required licenses and indemnify PBK and MEA from administrative, statutory, and legal responsibilities for its services.

expected_evidence.anchor: obtain all the required /relevant licenses, registrations

cases.question: When can the performance security be forfeited?
cases.expected_answer: It may be forfeited for specified damage or loss, breach or negligence, non-observance of terms, unsatisfactory performance, or nonacceptance of the work order.

expected_evidence.anchor: Performance Security will be forfeited

cases.question: What secrecy obligation applies to security manpower?
cases.expected_answer: Security manpower must maintain complete secrecy, must not divulge information obtained during operations, and must maintain secrecy after termination.

expected_evidence.anchor: will maintain complete secrecy regarding the entire arrangements

cases.question: What does the force majeure clause require the provider to do after an event arises?
cases.expected_answer: The provider must promptly notify the authority in writing, continue performance as reasonably practical unless directed otherwise, and seek alternatives.

expected_evidence.anchor: shall promptly notify the authority in writing
continue to perform its obligations under the contract

targets.anchor: shall promptly notify the authority in writing
continue to perform its obligations under the contract

cases.question: Who has the final decision on whether a breach occurred?
cases.expected_answer: The decision of MEA or its nominee on whether a breach occurred is final and binding on that point.

expected_evidence.anchor: decision of MEA and/or his nominee shall be final and binding

cases.question: Which labour legislation must the agency comply with for its licence?
cases.expected_answer: The agency must comply with the legal requirements for obtaining a licence under the Contract Labour (R&A) Act, 1970.

expected_evidence.anchor: license under Contract Labour (R&A) Act, 1970

cases.question: What potential operational risk follows if the provider lacks required manpower or equipment?
cases.expected_answer: A potential product risk is recurring bill deductions and penalties for manpower or equipment shortfalls.

expected_evidence.anchor: If the required numbers of workers/supervisors are less than specified

cases.question: What potential risk is created by the extension language?
cases.expected_answer: The contract presents a potential renewal and continuity risk because extensions are conditional on satisfactory service and MEA retains discretion over requirements.

expected_evidence.anchor: may be extended two times, by one year at a time

cases.question: Which provision supports the one-month termination notice after breach?
cases.expected_answer: The termination clause states that MEA may terminate after giving one month's notice when the agency commits a breach.

expected_evidence.anchor: In case the Agency commits any breach

cases.question: What is the exact awarded contractor name in the document?
cases.expected_answer: The exact awarded contractor name cannot be determined from this tender document and its blank agreement fields.
cases.provenance: Whole document review; contractor fields remain blank

cases.question: What exact monthly contract amount was finally agreed?
cases.expected_answer: The final monthly contract amount cannot be determined because the financial schedule contains blank amount fields.

cases.question: What exact date did the executed agreement commence?
cases.expected_answer: The exact commencement date cannot be determined because the duration clause contains blank start and end fields.
